pāparata.p: [ pāpa + rata ] (ti) Google Translate who delights in evil; he.

မကောင်းမှု၌ မွေ့လျော်သည်။

pāparogī.p: [ pāparoga + ī ] (ti) Google Translate Evil-evil-sickness, sick, he. (Persons with rare diseases such as rheumatism, horse-bite disease, gonorrhea, gallstone disease, phlegm disease, cough, and gynecological disease.)

အနာပင်းစွဲသော （သူ）။
DOP: pāpa mfn., m.f. (~ā, ~ī) and n. [ ts ], 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) (what/who is) bad, evil, wicked; morally wrong; injurious (with unpleasant consequences); Vin II 196, 5 (yāva ~o ayaṃ Devadatto alakkhiko); III 19, 28 (atthi me ~aṃ kammaṃ kataṃ purāṇadutiyikāya methuno dhammo paṭisevito, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-kammaṃ); IV 157, 31 (nārahatāyaṃ puriso ~o hotuṃ yathā bhagavantaṃ payirupāsatī ti); A V 86, 20 foll. (ko paccayo ~assa kammassa kiriyāya ~assa kammassa pavattiyā ti); Dhp 136 (atha ~āni kammāni karaṃ bālo na bujjhati); Sn 57 (~aṃ sahāyaṃ parivajjayetha); Pv 3:2 (samaṇo ahaṃ ~o); Th 1018 (~o kāpurisena saṅgamo); Ja III 476, 6 (mātugāmo nāma ~o nillajjo akataññū mittadubbhī ti); IV 53, 7* (~āni kammāni vivajjayāma; 54, 8´ foll.: sabbāni nirayagāmīni lāmakakammāni); 430, 19 (āvuso Devadatto sayaṃ pi ~o parisā pi ’ssa ~ā, iti so ~o °-parivāro va viharatī ti); VI 236, 31* (~aṃ sahāyaṃ āgamma bahuṃ ~aṃ kataṃ mayā); 239, 8* (kalyāṇaṃ yadi vā ~aṃ na hi kammaṃ panassati); Cp 2:5:4 (ath’ ettha kapi-m-āgantvā ~o anariyo lahu; Cp-a 141, 15 : ~o ti lāmako); Mil 122, 20 (coriyā dhuttiyā … ~iyā, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se pāpikāya); Pj II 109, 15 (dasavatthukāya °-diṭṭhiyā samannāgatattā ~o); — ( ii ) bad, unpleasant; poor, inferior; Ja V 441, 2 (hatthapādamukha-akkhināsāni ~āni virūpāni ahesuṃ, tena naṃ Pañcapāpā t’ eva sañjāniṃsu); — 2. ( m.f. ) a bad or evil person; a wrong-doer; Vin III 90, 26* (~ā ~ehi kammehi nirayaṃ te upapajjare) = Dhp 307; M I 125, 20 (~i dāsi divā uṭṭhāsī ti, Be, Ee so; Ce ~ī dāsī; Se pāpadāsi; Ps II 99, 10 : atha kasmā ~i dāsi divā uṭṭhāsī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pāpadāsi); Dhp 119 (~o pi passatī bhadraṃ yāva ~aṃ na paccati; Dhp-a III 14, 8 : ~o ti kāyaduccaritādinā °-kammena yuttapuggalo); Ja I 488, 17 (~e nissāya hi sukhaṃ nāma natthi); II 136, 26 (sā pi ~ā puna manasā pi aticarituṃ nāsakkhi); IV 91, 9 (so pi ~o … Bārāṇasiṃ agamāsi); Cp 2:8:7 (pathaṃ ~ass’ adās’ ahaṃ); Dhp-a II 72, 20 (iminā kira ~ena paccekabuddho pahaṭo); Mhv 34:14 (lokantarikanirayaṃ ~o so upapajjatha); — 3. ( n., pl. acc. also pāpe) ( i ) evil, wrong-doing; a bad, injurious action (involving unpleasant consequences); Abh 84; Vin I 73, 28 (mayaṃ kho yuddhābhinandino gacchantā ~aṃ ca karoma bahuṃ ca apuññaṃ pasavāma); III 72, 7 (kataṃ tayā kalyāṇaṃ akataṃ tayā ~aṃ, kiṃ tuyh’ iminā pāpakena dujjīvitena); D I 52, 29 (yo … pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya natthi tatonidānaṃ ~aṃ natthi ~assa āgamo); S I 12, 19* (~aṃ na kayirā vacasā manasā kāyena vā kiñcana sabbaloke); 72, 12* (attānaṃ ce piyaṃ jaññā na naṃ ~ena saṃyuje); A II 6, 12* (kāme ca ~e ca asevamāno); Dhp 17 (~aṃ me katan ti tappati bhiyyo tappati duggatiṃ gato); 116 (abhittharetha kalyāṇe ~ā cittaṃ nivāraye dandhaṃ hi karoto puññaṃ ~asmiṃ ramatī mano); 121 (bālo pūrati ~assa thokathokaṃ pi ācinaṃ); 265 (yo ca sameti ~āni aṇuṃthūlāni sabbaso); 267 (yo ’dha puññaṃ ca ~aṃ ca bāhetvā brahmacariyavā); 333 (~ānaṃ akaraṇaṃ sukhaṃ); It 33, 12 (~aṃ pāpakato passathā ti ayaṃ paṭhamā dhammadesanā); Sn 22 (gopī mama assavā alolā … tassā na suṇāmi kiñci ~aṃ; Pj II 36, 10 foll.: itthannāmena nāma saddhiṃ imāya bhāsitaṃ vā lapitaṃ vā ti evaṃ tassā na suṇāmi kiñci aticāradosan ti dasseti); 399 (madā hi ~āni karonti bālā); 662 (yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati … tam eva bālaṃ pacceti ~aṃ); 790 (puññe ca ~e ca anūpalitto); Pv 6:6 (sapattī me gabbhinī āsi tassā ~aṃ acetayiṃ; Pv-a 34, 13 : ~aṃ luddakaṃ kammaṃ cetesiṃ); 11:2 (manussabhūtā kim akattha ~aṃ yen’ aññamaññassa pivātha lohitaṃ); 36:50 (khiḍḍāya yakkho pasavitva ~aṃ); Th 346 (yaṃ mayā pakataṃ ~aṃ pubbe aññāsu jātisu taṃ dānīdha pavāhemi); Thī 243 (sace imā nadiyo te ~aṃ pubbekataṃ vaheyyuṃ puññaṃ p’ imā vaheyyuṃ); Ja I 131, 15´ (apāyabhayena ~assa akaraṇaṃ veditabbaṃ); 414, 17 (so pi nirayasatto attano ~e khīṇe yathākammaṃ gato); III 66, 3´ (tasmiṃ maṃ paṭicca kate ~e mama nu kho etaṃ ~an ti); V 219, 19* (yo issaro ’mhī ti karoti ~aṃ); 426, 22´ (kilesena anuḍayhamānā khujjena saddhiṃ ~aṃ karoti); Bv 2:12 (yathā pi ~e vijjante kalyāṇam api vijjati); Mil 256, 17 (ajānantena pi kataṃ ~aṃ abhisamayantarāyakaraṃ hoti); Vism 465, 1 foll. (attānaṃ garuṃ katvā hiriyā ~aṃ jahāti … paraṃ garuṃ katvā ottappena ~aṃ jahāti); Sp 59, 20 (ahaṃ bhante ekaṃ amaccaṃ … adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametvā uposathaṃ kārehī ti pahiṇiṃ, so … ettake bhikkhū jīvitā voropesi, etaṃ ~aṃ kassa hotīti); 60, 8 (sace te natthi cittaṃ natthi ~aṃ); — ( ii ) evil, a bad thing; trouble; Dhp 119 (~o pi passatī bhadraṃ yāva ~aṃ na paccati yadā ca paccatī ~aṃ atha ~o ~āni passati; Dhp-a III 14, 15 : diṭṭhadhamme vividhā kammakāraṇā samparāye ca apāyadukkhaṃ anubhonto so ~o ~āni passati); Ja II 146, 16* (sabbe bhadrāni passantu mā kañci ~am āgamā; 146, 23´ : ekaṃ pi sattaṃ ~aṃ lāmakaṃ dukkhaṃ mā āgamā); III 418, 18* (āgamissati me ~aṃ āgamissati me bhayaṃ; 418, 20´ : ~an ti lāmakaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ akantaṃ); — pāpā in Ee at Th 771 is wr for pādā ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — ° âdhimuttika , mfn. , whose inclinations are bad; intent on evil; Vibh 341, 28 ; — ° âbhijātika , mfn. , of low birth; M II 222, 15 ; — °’- iccha , mfn. , whose wishes are blameworthy or base (who pretends to have excellent qualities in a wish for gain); Vin I 97, 10 (yo bhikkhu ~o icchāpakato asantaṃ abhūtaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ ullapati); II 196, 24 (mā ~ā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅghaṃ bhindeyyuṃ); 203, 2 (~-tā °-mittatā); D III 246, 29 (~o hoti micchādiṭṭhi); S I 150, 4 (~ā bhante SāriputtaMoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā ti); A V 150, 9 (~ā bhikkhave nigaṇṭhā); It 34, 16* (~o ahiriko anādaro); Sn 280; Th 987; Mil 357, 8 (puggalo ~o icchāpakato kuhako luddho …); Vism 24, 1 (~assā ti asantaguṇadīpanakāmassa); — °’- icchā , f. , a blameworthy or base desire; Vibh 389, 35 ; — °’- ū̆pasevanā , f. , association with evil people; Ja VI 235, 29 ; — °- kamma , n. and mf ( n )., 1. ( n. ) an evil or wicked deed; a morally wrong action; D III 182, 4 ; M I 39, 10 (Bāhukāya ca pana nadiyā bahujano ~aṃ kataṃ pavāhetī ti, Be, Se so; Ce pāpakaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ; Ee pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ); Pv 7:2 (~aṃ karitvāna petalokaṃ ito gatā); Ja I 130, 10´ foll.; Nidd I 404, 8 (na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ ~aṃ vyantīhoti); Mil 84, 13 ; — 2. ( mf. ) acting wickedly; a wrong-doer; M II 80, 7 (~ā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti); A III 354, 6* ; Vv 84:30; Thī 452 (socanti ~ā vinipāte °-buddhino); — neg. apāpakamma, mf ( n )., Ja V 412, 3´ ; — °- kammanta , m.f. and n. , 1. ( m.f. ) (one) whose actions are evil; a wrong-doer; S I 97, 30* (yathākammaṃ gamissanti … nirayaṃ ~ā); Pv 42:10 (paccanti ~ā isim āsajja subbataṃ); Ja VI 104, 20* ; Nidd I 405, 12* (ḍahanto ~e); Pj II 192, 17 (~ā ete na ete brāhmaṇā); — 2. ( n. ) an evil deed; a wrong action; Nidd I 405, 31* (tesaṃ ca ~aṃ avipakkaṃ kataṃ bahuṃ); — °- kammi(n) , m.f. , (one) whose actions are evil; a wrong-doer; M I 39, 18* (na hi naṃ sodhaye ~inaṃ); Dhp 126; Thī 242 (corā ca vajjhaghātā ca ye aññe ~ino); Ja V 270, 19´ (bahū ~ino); VI 105, 3* (niraye tāva passāmi āvāse ~inaṃ); Vism 548, 28 (~ino puggalassa); Dhp-a II 9, 7 ; — neg. apāpakammi(n), m.f. , Ja V 411, 30* ; — supāpakammi(n), m.f. , a great wrong-doer; Ja V 143, 13* ; — °- garahi(n) , mfn. , censuring wrong-doing or wrong-doers; S I 63, 32 (~ī bhante āyasmā Sāriputto; Spk I 124, 5 foll.: °-puggale pi garahati … °-dhamme pi garahatī ti); Mil 380, 22 ; Vism 239, 11 ; Sp 740, 30 (~i-tāya); Spk III 223, 1 (~issa dhātuyo); Dhp-a I 17, 15* ; — °- cetasa , mfn. , whose thinking is evil or wrong; S I 70, 33* = It 45, 16* (It-a II 2, 21 : ~an ti akusaladhammasamāyogato lāmakacittaṃ); Pv 38:21 (puriso ~o); — °- jigucchaka , mfn. , spurning, recoiling from, morally wrong action; Ps II 43, 21 ≠ Spk I 126, 28 ; — °- jegucchi(n) , mfn. , detesting, recoiling from, morally wrong action; Mil 352, 10 ; — °- tara , mfn. , (what is) worse; (who is) more wrong; A II 222, 22 (pāpaṃ ca vo bhikkhave desessāmi pāpena ~aṃ); 222, 29 (katamo … pāpena ~o); Ja I 158, 25´ ; IV 405, 12* (pāpā ~o hoti); V 507, 17 (pāpamittasaṃsaggato ca ~aṃ nāma natthī ti); Sadd 792, 11 ; — °- tama , mfn. , most evil; worst; Sadd 792, 11 ; — °- dhammi(n) , mfn. , of evil ways; — supāpadhammi(n), mfn. , of very evil ways; Pv 11:7; Ja VI 107, 22* ; — °- bhīru , mfn. , fearful of doing wrong; scrupulous; Abh 158 (ottappaṃ ~-tā); Cp-a 202, 8 ; 227, 17 (nirayabhayaṃ ~-tā rajjajigucchā); — °- bhīruka , mfn. , id.; Vism 7, 26 ; Spk II 142, 18 (ottāpino ~ā); — °- bhūmi , mfn. , with inferior, poor, soil; S IV 315, 5 (ekaṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ … ~i … aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ … ~ī ti, Be so; Ce, Se ~i … ~in ti; Ee °-bhūmikaṃ … ~in ti); — °- mitta , m. and mfn. , 1. ( m. ) a bad friend; a friend who is immoral, influencing one to wrong-doing; A III 422, 9 ; Th 264 (~e vivajjetvā); Ja III 399, 21´ (~e veripuggale anupasaṅkamanto); Ap 430, 9 ; — 2. ( mfn. ) cultivating the friendship of a bad man or bad men; having bad men as one’s friends and advisors; following the example of wrongdoers; D II 78, 18 (yāvakīvaṃ … bhikkhū na ~ā bhavissanti na °-sahāyā na °-sampavaṅkā); S I 83, 27 (rājā … māgadho Ajātasattu vedehiputto ~o °-sahāyo °-sampavaṅko; Spk I 154, 15 : pāpā Devadattādayo mittā assā ti ~o); A I 83, 28 (dovacassatā ca ~-tā ca); 126, 21 ; Vibh 359, 28 (~-tā); — °- rogi(n) , mf ( n )., suffering from a bad disease; Vin I 91, 13 foll. (~iṃ pabbājent; Sp 1027, 30 : ~ī ti … yena kenaci rogena niccāturo atekiccharogo jeguccho amanāpo ayaṃ pi na pabbājetabbo); — °- saṅgatika , mfn. , having an evil fate; unfortunate; M II 222, 12 (sace bhikkhave sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti addhā bhikkhave niganṭhā ~ā; Ps IV 10, 6 : °-niyatino); — °- sampavaṅka , mfn. , influenced by a wicked man or wicked men; inclining towards, associating with, people of bad qualities; D II 78, 19 ; S I 83, 27 ; A I 126, 21 ; Ja III 323, 22* (na ~ena mātā puttena nandati); — °- sahāya , mfn. , having the companionship of an evil man or evil men; associating with people of bad qualities; D II 78, 19 ; S I 83, 27 ; A I 126, 21 ; — °- supina , m. , a bad dream; Ja VI 186, 23 (mayā kakkhaḷo ~o diṭṭho); Ap 271, 21 (na ~assāhaṃ sarāmi dassanaṃ mama); Dhp-a I 216, 6 (ajja mayā ~o diṭṭho); — apāpa , mfn. , not bad, good; Ja II 415, 4* (~assa katapuññassa jantuno); IV 313, 12* ; VI 155, 21* ; — atipāpa, mfn. , very bad; Pj II 309, 28 ; — nippāpa, mfn. , without evil; free from wrong-doing; Dhp 205 = Sn 257 = Ja III 196, 23* ; Pj II 36, 22 ; — see also ninhātasabbapāpa ( sv ninhāta ), puññapāpapahīna ( sv puñña ).
